Antwerp: gold holds at €120,58 a gram, Friday's close still the tape's last verified session.

Kitco's spot was flat at $4,347.70 an ounce; the ECB's euro reference rate of 1.1592 set the board. Rapaport's RAPI benchmark held at $3,903.07 a carat, roughly €3,367 — unchanged for a second session.

Antwerpen: goud blijft op €120,58 per gram, bij de laatst geverifieerde slotkoers van de tape.
